Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/h3 && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src/apps/filters/gridDiskUnsafe.c","function":"main","line":94,"var":"buff","code":"H3Index h3 = H3_EXPORT(stringToH3)(buff);","note":"Attacker-controlled stdin line is copied into buff and parsed as an H3 index string."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/h3lib/lib/h3Index.c","function":"stringToH3","line":58,"var":"str","code":"sscanf(str, \"%PRIx64\", &h);","note":"The parser accepts the raw string and converts it to a 64-bit H3Index value without validating that the text is a canonical cell index."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/apps/filters/gridDiskUnsafe.c","function":"doCell","line":37,"var":"h","code":"if (!H3_EXPORT(gridDiskUnsafe)(h, k, rings)) {","note":"The parsed index is passed into the k-ring computation used by the vulnerable candidate."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/h3lib/lib/algos.c","function":"gridDiskUnsafe","line":484,"var":"origin","code":"return H3_EXPORT(gridDiskDistancesUnsafe)(origin, k, out, NULL);","note":"gridDiskUnsafe forwards the attacker-controlled origin directly into the distance-based ring walker."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/h3lib/lib/algos.c","function":"gridDiskDistancesUnsafe","line":538,"var":"origin","code":"origin = h3NeighborRotations(origin, DIRECTIONS[direction], &rotations);","note":"The ring walker derives neighbors from the supplied origin before any validation of the digit layout, so malformed digits can influence neighbor traversal."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/h3lib/lib/algos.c","function":"h3NeighborRotations","line":320,"var":"oldDigit","code":"Direction oldDigit = H3_GET_INDEX_DIGIT(out, r + 1);","note":"Neighbor traversal reads index digits directly and uses them as table indices while walking to adjacent cells."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/h3lib/lib/algos.c","function":"h3NeighborRotations","line":331,"var":"NEW_DIGIT_II[oldDigit][dir]","code":"H3_SET_INDEX_DIGIT(out, r + 1, NEW_DIGIT_II[oldDigit][dir]);","note":"If an invalid digit reaches this helper, the digit lookup can go out of the intended domain and corrupt the traversal state."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/h3lib/lib/h3Index.c","function":"isValidCell","line":107,"var":"digit","code":"if (digit < CENTER_DIGIT || digit >= NUM_DIGITS) return 0;","note":"The root cause is that invalid digits are only rejected by validation, but the unsafe k-ring path does not validate before using digit-dependent traversal helpers, enabling the crash."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p.read_text())
